subject: Request to expunge prompts/outputs/logs for ACME - Project Nova
messages:
From: Jordan Tal <jordan.tal@acme-corp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Security <security@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request to expunge prompts/outputs/logs for ACME - Project Nova

Hi Kimberly,

We need Redwood to expunge all prompt/assistant output artifacts and request-related inference logs tied to Project Nova (internal id: NOVA-81). This is a formal privacy request from ACME's data governance team — they want confirmation that prompts, generated outputs, and non-essential inference logs will be removed from active stores and that any retained backups will be handled per your policy.

Key asks:
- Scope: prompts + outputs + per-request logs (not aggregated telemetry).
- Evidence: we need a confirmation email once deletion is complete and a short audit record showing what was removed and timestamps.
- Timeline: requested ASAP; target window: within 14 calendar days.

Please confirm process, estimated timeline, and any required forms. Happy to route a formal PDF request if you need it.

Thanks,
Jordan Tal
Senior Data Governance Manager
ACME Corp
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Tal <jordan.tal@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 13:45:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to expunge prompts/outputs/logs for ACME - Project Nova

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. We can proceed. Below is the standard expunge workflow we will use and what we will deliver back to ACME:

1) Intake & authorization (day 0)
   - ACME confirms requester and signs the expunge request form (attached).
2) Scope verification (day 1-2)
   - Teams validate the identifier mapping (NOVA-81) across prompt-output stores, quick KV cache, and request logs.
3) Execution (day 3-7)
   - Delete prompts and generated outputs from live object stores and DB rows flagged for removal.
   - Remove per-request inference logs from the request-level log table and clear associated ephemeral KV entries.
4) Backups & retention hold (day 7-30)
   - Backups/snapshots are handled per our backup retention policy; we will schedule targeted retention-lift and scrub of snapshots that contain NOVA-81 artifacts. This step can require up to 30 days depending on snapshot windows.
5) Evidence package & confirmation (day 3-30)
   - We will provide: (a) a deletion manifest (filenames/keys and DB row ids), (b) timestamped log entries showing deletion operations, (c) a short narrative of actions taken.

Attachments: expunge_runbook_v2.pdf (internal runbook), acme_expunge_request_form.pdf (please sign and return).

Notes / constraints:
- Aggregated telemetry (metrics/usage counts) is not part of this scope and is retained per our telemetry retention policy; we only remove per-request artifacts unless otherwise requested and agreed in writing.
- If ACME requires deletion from cold backups before the snapshot window, please confirm in writing; we will escalate to our infra team and provide a realistic timeline (can exceed 30 days).

Next steps: please sign the attached request form and reply to this thread to authorize the expunge. Once we have your signed request we will kick off the scope verification and share a JIRA ticket for tracking.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to expunge prompts/outputs/logs for ACME - Project Nova

Kim / Monica — quick legal/privacy note to include in communications to ACME:

- We must obtain an authorized signer from ACME (name, title, and email) on the attached PDF request form before performing destructive operations. We should not start deletion until that form is returned and logged in PRIV-4521.
- Provide ACME with a standardized audit package template (deletion manifest + operation timestamps + operator id). Avoid including low-level system logs that contain unrelated customer identifiers.
- If they request deletion from backups that impact multiple customer snapshots, we need Exec approval (documented). Communicate that such cross-customer operations may introduce extended timelines.

Also: Monica, please prepare the audit-template that will be delivered to the customer. I recommend including a redacted sample for their review.

Rishi
VP Legal & Privacy
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Tal <jordan.tal@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to expunge prompts/outputs/logs for ACME - Project Nova

Hi Jordan — thanks for the request and for confirming who will sign on ACME's side. My team will own the execution and I'll be the main point of contact.

Summary of what we will do once we receive the signed authorization:
- Kick off verification mapping for NOVA-81 (expected 24–48 hours).
- Execute deletions from live stores (expected 48–72 hours after verification).
- Schedule snapshot/backups scrub (if requested) and provide best-effort ETA (can be up to 30 days).
- Deliver audit package: deletion manifest, operator IDs, and deletion timestamps.

Below is the confirmation email we will send back to ACME once the deletion is complete — feel free to confirm language, or suggest edits:

---- confirmation template ----
Subject: Confirmation of expunge for Project Nova (NOVA-81)
Body:
Hello Jordan,

This email confirms Redwood Inference has completed the requested expunge for Project Nova (NOVA-81). Items removed: prompts, generated outputs, and per-request inference logs as scoped.

What we are sending: deletion_manifest.csv (list of removed keys/row ids), deletions_log.txt (timestamped operations), and a brief narrative of the steps taken.

If you requested backup/snapshot scrub, please note that process may remain in progress; we will update you when snapshot-level deletion is complete.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
---- end template ----

Attached: acme_expunge_request_form.pdf (signed request from ACME will be returned here).

Links: PRIV-4521 (tracking) — https://redwoodai.atlassian.net/browse/PRIV-4521

Let me know when you've routed the signed form and I'll create the JIRA and schedule the work.

Best,
Monica

Please proceed and reply with the JIRA ticket once created.

Jordan Tal
